what: the demo's recorded inputs: no demo online (no options screen, no idle check)
LDA $CFF7 (the idle check: after a while without input the demo) -> JMP $6718
LDA #$FF / STA $7B (after a game: a new one) -> JMP spy_over
LDA #$03 / STA $DD02 (the VIC bank's data direction) -> #$07: PA2 (the WiC64's handshake) stays an output
LDA $41 / STA $42 (a pass of the main loop) -> JSR spy_tick
the random seed: LDA $D012 plus the sum of $03-$FF -> spy_seed
the IRQ before a game: JSR $94A1 (joysticks, keys) -> spy_frame
the IRQ: JSR $9362 (the clocks) and JSR $94A1 (joysticks, keys) -> the tick's
the IRQ's exit (PLA / TAY / PLA / TAX / PLA / RTI) -> JMP spy_irqend (own screen)
the IRQ: LDA $0255,X / STA $D021 (a half's colour) -> JSR spy_irqhalf (own screen)
